notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer, Podrace Prep, Credits Will Do Fine and Brisky Morning Munchen; these count toward the 60. Two Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.
Posted 'The Hyperdrive's Gone/I'll Be Damned' dested The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One (the only Light Hyperdrive objective; the flip-side name is posted wrong).

Posted 'Shmi's Hut' dested Tatooine: Slave Quarters (deploys Shmi from Reserve Deck; Tatooine: Skywalker Hut is a later Virtual card); 'Marketplace' dested Tatooine: Marketplace; 'Qui-Gon's Saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, after this post); 'Cap'n Panaka' dested Captain Panaka; 'Padme' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Threepio w/ Parts Showing' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Tatooine Mos Epsa' dested Tatooine: Mos Espa.
The description ('DAVE') and strategy ('Jokes On U1') are as published; the list itself is a complete 60-card deck.
The card list is the same as deck 19117, "Ep1 Drive-by Munchen (THGG)", posted the same day by Kenneth Bradford.
